normative_extracts.quote: When an event is retargeted against a shadow root boundary, its target is adjusted to the shadow host for listeners outside the shadow tree.

browser_support.notes: Shadow DOM v1 is Baseline Widely; Declarative Shadow DOM (<template shadowrootmode>) shipped across all engines in 2024.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Shadow DOM isolates a scoped DOM and CSS tree behind a ShadowRoot, composing light-DOM children via <slot> and retargeting bubbling events to the host.

production_failures.symptom: Global analytics click handler reports event.target as <my-card> instead of the inner <button>
production_failures.root_cause: Composed events crossing a ShadowRoot boundary are retargeted to the shadow host so outer listeners cannot inspect internal DOM.
production_failures.mitigation: Inspect event.composedPath()[0] when open shadow internals must be audited, or dispatch custom composed events from the host.

production_failures.symptom: ARIA aria-labelledby or form <label for='id'> fails across a ShadowRoot boundary
production_failures.root_cause: ID references are scoped to their own DOM tree and cannot cross ShadowRoot boundaries.
production_failures.mitigation: Keep label and input inside the same shadow tree, or use ElementInternals / Reference Target.
